full_page.content:
1946, November 26
The following is a faithful transcription of a photo copy of messages written on Post Cards by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
"O all ye works of the Lord! Bless the Lord. ... forever!" Nov. 26th, 1946
God bless you His lamb with Philip and all the rest. I am glad you are well. You always seem well out there. I have been here since last April. Thanks be to God it is quite an ideal place - 18 novices. The youngest about 17 ... to 23. Hope philip keeps well. Our Fr. Julius is down there some where in Tucson. He expects to go in Jan- uary to the Guam Missions. There has been some talk of our getting a place in Tucson.
.
.. Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Bless the Lord in all things
July 12th, 1947
God bless you Miss Lamb - you and yours. Glad to hear from you - and about Philip. I hope that operation - and preparation therefor, may be not too serious.
At all events try and avoid anxiety - and trust in our Dear Lord for Every thing.
Best wishes and God's grace to all.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.C.
Originals in possession of: Miss Beatrice Lamb 36087 Bartell St. Richmond, Michigan 48062
